question: When you are approaching a stationary vehicle with a driver in it, you should

options.text: Drive past him quickly so as not to obstruct him.
Slow down a little because he may move out suddenly.
Drive at the same speed because it is his duty to check passing traffic.

question: When driving a car you are not familiar with, you should first test

options.text: How fast it can go in the 1st gear.
How much space it requires to make a turn.
How effective its brakes are.

question: Before opening your car door, you should look out for

options.text: Passsers-by and other motor vehicles.
Cyclist and motorcyclist.
All the above.

notes: Source typo in option A: 'Passsers-by' (three s) kept as printed.

question: When changing gear, you should look

options.text: Down at the gear lever.
At the road ahead.
Down at the clutch pedal.

question: The correct way of braking is to

options.text: Press the brake pedal early and hard and then reduce pressure gradually.
Press the brake pedal late and hard until the vehicle comes to a stop.
Press hard on the brake and clutch pedal together till vehicle stops.

question: The handbrake is used

options.text: When driving up a hill.
To control the speed of the car.
When the car is stationary during stopping, waiting and parking.

question: When your car breaks down on an expressway, a red triangle breakdown sign should be placed

options.text: On the top of your car.
Beside your car.
At least 20 metres behind your car.

question: In the situation as shown, the motor car should
picture: Overhead video frame: red car with a motorcyclist alongside on its left, approaching a side road on the left

options.text: Slow down and turn after the motorcyclist.
Speed up and turn before the motorcyclist reaches the junction.
Turn side by side with the motorcyclist.

notes: Picture panel is a video frame with a Repeat Video button.

question: In a traffic hold-up situation as shown, vehicle 'X' should
picture: Overhead video frame of a junction in queued traffic: red car X, blue car Y in a side road, space marked Z

options.text: Leave some space for vehicle Y to move out.
Move to the position 'Z'.
Turn left instead.

notes: Picture panel is a video frame with a Repeat Video button.

question: Which of the following statements on alcohol and driving is true?

options.text: It is safe to drive as long as you think you are not drunk.
It is unsafe to drive after consuming alcohol.
It is safe to drive one hour after having the last drink.

question: You are on a clear and open road in good weather condition, the distance between you and the vehicle in front should be

options.text: One car's length.
Two car's length.
Two second time gap.

notes: Option B 'Two car's length.' is printed with the apostrophe as shown (grammatically odd), kept as printed.

question: A person will not be allowed to register for a test if he has accumulated

options.text: 10 demerit points.
12 demerit points.
13 demerit points.

question: You will not be allowed to apply for a driving test date if you have

options.text: 10 demerit points.
12 demerit points.
13 demerit points.

notes: Same options as Q12 with slightly different question wording.

question: When you hear the siren of an emergency vehicle but are not sure where it is coming from, you should

options.text: Continue to drive at the same speed.
Move to the side and stop if necessary.
Drive faster so as not to obstruct the emergency vehicle.

question: When passing a parked vehicle, you should leave a safe gap of at least

options.text: 0.3 metre between your vehicle and the parked vehicle.
0.5 metre between your vehicle and the parked vehicle.
1.0 metre between your vehicle and the parked vehicle.

question: After you have driven through a flood, you should check

options.text: Your lights.
Your brakes.
Your tyres.

question: An automatic car has two foot pedals

options.text: The brake and clutch pedals.
The accelerator and brake pedals.
The clutch and accelerator pedals.

question: A basic rule when driving on an expressway is

options.text: To use the lane that has least traffic.
To keep to the left lane unless overtaking.
Always use the road shoulder.

question: If you missed the exit on an expressway, you should

options.text: Stop and wait for a chance to reverse back to the exit
Carry on driving to the next exit
Reverse as quickly as possible so as not to create confusion

notes: None of the three options ends with a full stop in the source.

question: When you have completed changing up to the 5th gear, you should

options.text: Depress the clutch pedal slightly.
Rest your left foot on the clutch pedal.
Rest your left foot on the floor board.
